text:
mia: Nightly eval flagged a large regression for v34 onboarding — ~14% drop on the list-merge promptset and a bunch of truncated codeblock outputs. samples below. @sam @jordan can you take a look? :eyes:

deploy-bot: nightly-eval v34 2026-03-19 02:11Z — regression alert: list-merge promptset failure rate ↑14%. tagged: eng-ml, triage.

sam: quick heads-up — I ran tokenizer diffs between v33 and v34. We removed the NFKC fold in the tokenizer normalizer to preserve some unicode sequences. emojis (esp compound ones) are now being split into extra subtokens. that shifts token ids downstream.

jordan: that token id shift is causing KV cache misalignment in the serving runtime for prefix lookups. small off-by-one in prefix length -> later tokens get stale KV. seeing truncation + hallucination spikes.

eva: also tried reproducible experiment: quantized v34 int8 increases the failure rate further (suggests error compounds with quantization noise).

mia: can you paste a short failing prompt + model outputs so we have a concrete repro?

sam: pasted below (cleaned):
```
PROMPT: "List the steps to reset a user's password for example.com account. Include MFA and email verification. Emoji: ☃️"

v33 (expected):
1) Go to account settings
2) Click "Security" -> Reset password
3) Verify via email link
4) Confirm MFA code

v34 (regressed):
1) Go to account settings
2) Click "Security" -> Reset password
3) Verify via email link
4) Confirm MFA code

-- but the generation often truncates after step 2 or repeats odd characters near the emoji.

tokens_v33: [101, 23, 45, 997, 564, 78]
tokens_v34: [101, 23, 45, 997, 12, 34, 564, 78]  <-- emoji split into extra subtokens causing index shift
```

leo: reproducer command (quick):
```
git checkout onboard/v34-tokenizer
python -m reproducer --model v34 --promptset list_merge --seed 42 --log-tokens
```

jordan: logs show cache lookups use original prefix length N from request metadata but tokenization returns N+1. The runtime expects token ids aligned with previous KV frames. So when we hit attention/cache restore we drop the last token and outputs garble.

mia: mitigation options: (1) reintroduce NFKC fold in tokenizer normalizer for v34 as a compatibility shim; (2) map new token ids back to old id-space before cache keying (compat layer in serving); (3) rollback tokenizer change in upstream weights and re-run nightly.

sam: I can open a small PR that applies a normalization shim at tokenization time (fast). Will also add a unit test to assert emoji tokenization parity with v33 for the anchored prompts. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/789 (draft).

eva: I'll add 6 anchor prompts that cover compound emojis, zero-width joiners, and language-specific punctuation to the nightly eval, so this won't slip.

jordan: I'll instrument a quick toplevel guard in runtime: if token_count != metadata.prefix_len then log a high-severity alert and fall back to cold-start path (disable KV cache for that request) to avoid corrupted outputs. cheap and safe.

mia: sounds good. priority: patch shim + hotfix guard in runtime -> rollback only if we see no improvement. Can someone owner the rollout? @jordan?

jordan: taking rollout. I'll push the guard as hotfix to canary infra and monitor 30m.

sam: running patched tokenizer tests locally now, will push PR by EOD.

eva: adding eval anchors and will run an extended overnight job.

mia: thanks all. keep thread posted with PR links and canary metrics. :thumbsup:

jordan: :thumbsup:
